speech.heard: In Jamaica, 80.7% of university faculty are women. In Dr. Congo, just 6.3%. Jamaica is the world's highest, with female professors leading classrooms across the island. At the opposite end, Togo has 6.1%, the world's lowest. In Germany, women hold 42% of academic staff posts. India has 44.3%. The United States sits at 51.7%, just above an even split. Russia stays higher with 59.6% where female scholars remain the majority. What percentage of university faculty are women in your country?
